name: Low-MAX Lottery-Avoidance Tilt
description: Long-only tilt toward the lowest-MAX assets (Bali, Cakici & Whitelaw 2011). MAX = the average of an asset's largest few daily returns over a trailing ~3-month window, a lottery-preference signal. Ranks ascending and equal-weights the bottom N, avoiding recently-spiking lottery-like assets. Distinct from volatility, IVOL and beta tilts.
